product.name: Ember Agent
product.description: A software component that provides real-time diagnostics and automated failure detection for robots, supporting built-in sensors like cameras, LiDARs, and IMUs.

product.name: Ember Dashboard
product.description: A monitoring interface that displays live sensor status, instant anomaly alerts, and historical performance trends for robotic systems.
